Implemented in modules/fit/shared (commit 986bc5a107fd5f8d9c8ed7c4cb7a00e1ee5bb905): BasisExpandedFitProduct retains conditions k, basis size J, the kJ x kJ partialled task Gram, kJ x V response cross-products X'y, per-voxel response squares and residual df. Design note: the kernel needs only X'y (= G bhat), never bhat itself, so the cross-product panel is the retained quantity; this makes a reprojection request O(kJ*V + k^2*V) instead of O((kJ)^2*V), which is what keeps a slider live. ContrastReprojection.reproject forms A = W'GW for shared basis weights (W = I_k kron w), Cholesky-solves once via Gale, and streams exact contrast, SE (sqrt(rss/df * c'A^-1 c)) and t maps; zero-residual voxels get se=0 and t=NaN. Typed ReprojectionError covers shape, non-finite, invalid-product and singular reduced Gram paths.

Evidence: ContrastReprojectionSuite 4/4 on fitJVM and fitJS; reprojection equals an independent time-domain OLS refit (explicit residual vectors) at 1e-9 for two distinct kernels/contrasts; full fitJVM 291/291 and fitJS 282/282.

Remaining scope moved to a follow-up bead: retention of the basis-expanded product through the SelectedEstimates/FirstLevelEstimates dataset path, and the real-subject verification leg owned by plsneuro C3.
